comment: Fake CUDA toolkit layout consumed by tools/build_shim_tree.py (cu-bridge tools/link.json + mock/stub_link.json parity, single source for cmake_cce/make_cce/pre_cce). Placeholders ${CUDA_DIR}, ${CUCC_PATH}, ${CANN_BASE}, ${HOST_TRIPLE}, ${NVCC_TARGET} are substituted by the builder. The CUDA-named lib64 alias family lets plain host-compiler links of -lcudart/-lcuda (and, experimental, -lcublas/-lnvToolsExt) resolve to the bridge runtime, exactly like cu-bridge's link.json pre_make section.

dir_links.comment: whole-tree link so all compatibility headers are visible; falls back to per-file links when a cross-filesystem link fails

file_links.comment: configure phase -> tools/nvcc_entry.sh (mock), build phase -> bin/cucc

host_tool_wrappers.comment: host-only Fortran carrier; rejects CUDA sources
host-only MPI carrier; rejects CUDA sources
